summary: [FE][MT] Verify Excel import (Create Multiple Work template, and the ETM-6843 Import Work and WB workflow) converts the Deck value to the Master Data spelling, and Y `a` becomes `A`
description_wiki:
*Scenario:* Checks that an Excel import turns the Deck value into the Master Data spelling and Y {{a}} into {{A}}.

*Precondition:* A user with View Worklist permission (see [Role & Permission|https://pttep.sharepoint.com/:x:/r/sites/TurnaroundManagement/Shared%20Documents/03%20Development/Role%20%26%20Permission%20V.2.xlsx?d=wa5e5a9a2071b4ed7b3ef83c4cf0dffd9&csf=1&web=1&e=3stFwC]) is logged in. {{Main Deck}} and {{Cellar Deck}} are Master Data Deck values. File 1 uses the template {{[Template] Import Worklist.xlsx}} (Deck, X and Y are in columns E to G) with one row: Work Number {{WK-X1}}, Deck {{main deck}}, X {{1}}, Y {{a}}. File 2 is an Excel file for Import Work and WB (ETM-6843) with one Work Breakdown row: Work Number {{WK-X3}}, Deck {{CELLAR deck}}. Worklist {{WL-A}} exists.

*Navigation Path:* Planning tab > Plan Card > Worklist item > Worklist page of {{WL-A}} > Create Work > Import Excel.
